candidate_decisions.reason: Bağlaç olma çekirdeği korunur; çevresel baskı, düşüşün önceki hükmü görünür kılan şart olmasıyla sınırlı tutulur.
وَ, ayahı 92:8-10'daki kişi tasvirine bağlayan sonuç ve sergileme ilişkisini açıkça kurar.
وَ ile مَا'nın doğrudan art arda gelişi, devam eden hükmü kısa bir yadsıma girişine çevirir ve ayrı bir ses/akış katkısı sağlar.
Yadsıma ve يُغْنِى, özne olan مَالُهُ açıklanmadan önce gelir; bu sıralama malın kurtarma işlevini daha adı konmadan tersine çevirir.
مَا, muzari fiili olgusal ve açık uçlu bir yadsıma içine alır; ifade emir ya da soru olarak kurulmamıştır.
مَا öncesindeki kısa bağlaçla birlikte kurulan kesik yadsıma başlangıcı, micro:c03 bulgusunda bu adayın anlamını eksiksiz taşır.
مَا yalnız mal adını değil, يُغْنِى fiilini, onun yöneldiği kişiyi ve gecikmiş özneyi birlikte yadsır.
يُغْنِى, doğrudan nesne yerine عَنْهُ ile kurularak yeterlik ve yararın belirli bir kişi için gerçekleşmesi gereken ilişkiyi gösterir.
IV. bâbın muzari biçimi, malın etkin biçimde yeterme/yarar sağlama kapasitesini yadsınan şey olarak kurar.
Aday yalnızca غ ن ي alanındaki şarkı, uzun süre yaşama ve benzeri dalların seçilmediğini kaydeder; yerel IV. bâb yapısı yeterme/yarar sağlama dalını seçer ve ek bir okuyucu değişikliği üretmez.
92:8'deki aynı غ ن ي alanı burada kişinin kendini yeterli saymasından malın o kişi için yeterli olma iddiasına döner ve yadsınır.
İlk bölüm genel faydasızlık hükmünü verir, zaman bölümü ise bu hükmün düşüş anında nasıl görünür olduğunu gösterir.
Gecikmiş isim, يُغْنِى fiilinin öznesidir; mal ile yeterme ilişkisi gevşek tema değil, ayah içi sözdizimsel temastır.
عَنْهُ, يُغْنِى fiilinin yönettiği kişi ekidir; fayda sağlayamamanın kimin üzerinden ölçüldüğünü belirler.
عَنْهُ, مَالُهُ ve son fiilin gizli öznesi aynı önceki erkek tekil katılımcıya bağlanır.
عَنْهُ tek yüzey kelimesinde ilişki edatını ve göndergeyi birleştirir; ardından gelen مَالُهُ aynı kişisel bağı tekrarlar.
مَالُهُ, faydasızlık hükmü verildikten sonra gelen belirli ve iyelikli merfu özne olarak beklenen kurtarıcıyı gecikmeli biçimde sahneye sokar.
مَالُهُ, soyut itibar değil, kişinin biriktirdiği somut ve toplanmış değerler olarak yerel ada uyar.
İyelik eki malı aynı kişinin şahsi kaynağı yapar; kişisel sahiplik, kurtarma gücünün yokluğuyla birlikte ironik bir temas kurar.
عَنْهُ ve مَالُهُ içindeki aynı هُ sesi, kişiyi ve ona ait malı işitsel olarak yan yana bağlar.
İsim, يُغْنِى fiilinin öznesi yapılarak sanki etkin bir failmiş gibi sınanır; yadsıma bu fail rolünün işlemediğini gösterir.

Malın burada tutulmuş kaynak, özne ve kurtarma sınavı olması packet içinde temellidir; daha sonraki 92:18'de verilen mal ile karşılaştırma micro packetinde seçilmiş bir bağlam olarak bulunmadığından ayrı bir bulgu oluşturmaz.
İyelikli mal, yadsınan يُغْنِى ilişkisine bağlanır ve düşüşte kurtaramayan somut kaynak olarak hükmü taşır.
إِذَا ile ardından gelen mazi fiil, düşüşü açık uçlu ihtimal değil, hükmün açığa çıktığı kesin zaman olarak kurar.
Zaman bölümü, önceki sıkıntı sonucunu belirsiz bir akıbet olarak bırakmaz; onu düşüşte görülen belirli bir olaya çevirir.
إِذَا, genel yadsıma ile onu görünür kılan düşüş sahnesini tek zaman cümlesinde menteşeler.
تَرَدَّىٰٓ, mazi üçüncü tekil erkek biçimi ve gizli öznesiyle önceki ayetlerdeki aynı kişiyi düşüşe taşır.
Ölüm/düşüş dalı yerel anlamı yönetir; örtü/giysi dalı yalnızca kişinin içine girdiği sonucu taşıyan sınırlı bir imge baskısı olarak korunur.
Son kelime zaman cümlesinin içinde yer alarak ilk yadsımanın sergilendiği sahneyi kapatır.
Sistemik çöküş, bu odak yüzeyinde ayrı bir taşıyıcı ve bağımsız tetikleyiciyle kurulmaz; supplied insan özne ve yerel düşüş anlamını genişletir.
ر د ي alanındaki düşüş ve helak ilişkisi, إِذَا'nın belirlediği anda malın yetersizliğini açığa çıkaran son yıkım sahnesini verir.
IV. bâbın dışarıdan yıktıran fail kurmaması ve V. bâbın yıkımı kişinin içine alan biçimde kurması aynı form ilişkisini micro:c34 bulgusunda birlikte taşır.

findings.title: Continuation under circumstantial pressure
findings.claim: وَ carries the preceding verdict into the wealth-futility clause, while the coming fall supplies the circumstance in which that verdict becomes visible.
findings.mechanism: The conjunction is the ordinary carrier; its immediately attached fall condition gives the preceding consequence a concrete disclosure setting.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause as an attached consequence under pressure, not as a detached maxim about wealth.
findings.containment: The conjunction remains the governing function; circumstantial pressure is a bounded local effect and does not replace the plain denial.

epistemic.reason: The supplied evidence makes conjunction primary and preserves the circumstantial value as a qualified local pressure.

findings.title: The opening consequence
findings.claim: وَ keeps this ayah attached to the preceding portrait, so the claim that wealth will not avail is a consequence and exhibit of that person rather than an isolated proverb.
findings.mechanism: The opening conjunction links the following negated predication to the same participant and prior discourse movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the wealth sentence arrives here: it answers the person already described.
findings.containment: This is a local discourse attachment to the supplied preceding surface, not a claim about the whole surah's architecture.

epistemic.reason: The QAC conjunction and supplied attachment evidence directly support the continuation relation.

findings.title: A clipped entry into denial
findings.claim: وَ and مَا arrive in a short linked onset, carrying continuation directly into denial before the heavier يُغْنِى unfolds.
findings.mechanism: The two particles remain distinct in analysis but occur as the surface launch of the same breath before the longer verb.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reversal before the resource is named or its capacity is explained.
findings.containment: The acoustic clipping supports the factual negation; it does not turn the statement into an emotional command or erase the ordinary translation.

epistemic.reason: The surface sequence and particle evidence support the onset, and the represented short-particle candidate adds no different semantic movement.

findings.title: Failure before the resource
findings.claim: The denial and يُغْنِى precede مَالُهُ, so wealth is introduced only after its ability to rescue has already been placed under failure.
findings.mechanism: Arabic places the negated verbal predication before its delayed nominative subject, making the expected agent arrive inside an already announced reversal.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader watches the alleged rescuer enter the sentence after the verdict against its rescue power.
findings.containment: The effect concerns clause order and meaning; it does not claim that the noun lacks its ordinary wealth meaning.

epistemic.reason: The supplied word order and same-root reversal evidence directly establish the delayed reversal.

findings.title: A factual statement of non-availing
findings.claim: مَا with the imperfect indicative makes the sentence a factual, open-ended denial of availing rather than an order, wish, or question.
findings.mechanism: The negative particle scopes over the indicative verbal form and leaves the clause asserting what does not occur.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader receives a settled verdict about capability at the crisis point.
findings.containment: The statement remains a denial of this availing relation; it does not generalize into a claim that wealth has no ordinary uses.

epistemic.reason: The supplied QAC and attachment evidence identify the negative particle and indicative predication.

findings.title: Negation over the whole test
findings.claim: مَا denies the whole يُغْنِى predication: the act of availing, the person it would benefit, and the wealth presented as its subject all fall within the denial.
findings.mechanism: The negative particle stands over the main verbal clause rather than attaching only to the later wealth noun.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah rejects an entire rescue event, not merely one quality of the possession.
findings.containment: The scope is the supplied first clause; it does not deny the existence or ordinary material reality of the wealth.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence explicitly place the first clause under the negative particle.

findings.title: The protected party is built into the verb
findings.claim: يُغْنِى directs sufficiency or benefit toward the person marked by عَنْهُ, so the failed capacity is personal rather than an abstract failure of wealth.
findings.mechanism: The Form IV verb is built with a governed prepositional complement instead of a direct object, making the affected person part of the availing relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can ask exactly for whom the wealth would have to work and sees that person's protection fail.
findings.containment: The relation identifies the affected beneficiary; it does not add a separate object or a broader theory of all wealth.

epistemic.reason: The supplied attachment evidence and lexical construction directly support the governed-person relation.

findings.title: Active capacity under denial
findings.claim: The Form IV imperfect presents wealth's active capacity to suffice, benefit, or avail as the capability that the ayah denies.
findings.mechanism: The causative verbal form makes the resource's efficacy an action under test, while مَا removes that capability in this clause.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the issue as whether the resource can actually act for its owner, not whether it merely exists.
findings.containment: The denied capability is the local availing function; the form does not erase the ordinary lexical field of wealth or sufficiency.

epistemic.reason: QAC form information and the supplied lexical construction support the capability reading.

findings.title: Self-sufficiency turned outward
findings.claim: The same غ ن ي field that described the person's self-sufficiency in 92:8 returns here as the question whether his wealth can make him sufficient, and that outward availing is denied.
findings.mechanism: The earlier self-assessment and the present Form IV construction share the field while changing the relation from being without need to conferring sufficiency on a person.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earlier appearance of independence tested as a concrete promise of rescue.
findings.containment: The reversal deepens the local denial; it does not declare that the earlier statement and this statement are competing translations.

epistemic.reason: The supplied same-root alignment and local construction support the reversal.

findings.title: The rule and its disclosure
findings.claim: The ayah first states that wealth does not avail and then names the fall as the event in which that non-availing becomes visible.
findings.mechanism: The negated main clause is followed by a temporal clause that supplies the manifestation point for the first clause.
findings.reader_payoff: A general verdict becomes a scene the reader can locate: the resource's failure is exposed at the fall.
findings.containment: The two-beat structure keeps the ordinary denial intact and does not make the scene a replacement for it.

epistemic.reason: The supplied clause structure and local crisis evidence directly support the two-beat movement.

findings.title: Wealth bound to sufficiency
findings.claim: مَالُهُ is the delayed subject of يُغْنِى, so wealth and sufficiency meet as one clause-bound test rather than as unrelated thematic words.
findings.mechanism: The noun's syntactic subject role creates a direct local relation between the stock of wealth and the verb's promised efficacy.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sentence place the possession itself on trial for the work of rescue.
findings.containment: The relation is local to this clause and does not activate every available meaning of either root.

epistemic.reason: The supplied syntax and support records establish the noun-verb pairing.

findings.title: Where protection fails
findings.claim: عَنْهُ marks the man as the party from whom need or harm would have to be averted, so the wealth's failure is measured against his protection.
findings.mechanism: The governed preposition attaches the pronoun to يُغْنِى and gives the availing relation its affected person.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial reach the man himself: wealth neither keeps ruin away from him nor effectively stands in for him.
findings.containment: The preposition remains a governed complement of availing; its protective and behalf nuances deepen the relation without replacing the plain "ona ... yarar sağlamaz."

epistemic.reason: Attachment and lexical evidence jointly support the protected-party relation.

findings.title: One participant through the clause
findings.claim: The suffix in عَنْهُ, the possessive suffix in مَالُهُ, and the hidden subject of تَرَدَّىٰٓ keep the same prior masculine participant in view.
findings.mechanism: The attachment chain carries one referent across the governed complement, the possessive noun, and the final verbal clause.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader follows one man from expected protection to owned wealth and then to the fall.
findings.containment: The pronoun continuity identifies the supplied discourse participant; it does not add an unexpressed new actor.

epistemic.reason: The supplied pronoun-chain attachment directly supports the continuing participant.

findings.title: Relation and person in one word
findings.claim: عَنْهُ fuses the relation of protection-away-from with its human referent, and the following مَالُهُ repeats the same person inside the possession.
findings.mechanism: A preposition and attached pronoun form one surface word, then the possessive suffix restates the referent on the wealth noun.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the man and his wealth bound together grammatically while the sentence denies that the wealth can act for him.
findings.containment: This is a local morphological and syntactic binding, not a claim that the two words become one semantic object.

epistemic.reason: The supplied surface and suffix evidence establish the fusion and repetition.

findings.title: The late-arriving subject
findings.claim: مَالُهُ arrives as the definite possessive subject of يُغْنِى only after the sentence has announced that the availing event fails.
findings.mechanism: Arabic delays the nominative subject until after the verb and its negated relation, assigning the possession an agent-like position inside a verdict against its agency.
findings.reader_payoff: The expected rescuer enters the scene already surrounded by failure.
findings.containment: The noun remains the ordinary possessed wealth; the grammatical agency is the ayah's test arrangement, not a claim that the object literally acts as a person.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the delayed possessive nominative subject.

findings.title: A concrete stock of wealth
findings.claim: مَالُهُ gathers the person's tangible accumulated property into one stock tested for efficacy.
findings.mechanism: The local noun selects the wealth/property branch and its singular mass-like form presents the accumulated stock as one resource.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader pictures material resources being tested, rather than only reputation or social standing.
findings.containment: The material reading stays within the supplied wealth gloss and does not activate all processes associated with the root.

epistemic.reason: The local lexical range and possessive noun support the concrete stockpile reading.

findings.title: The resource is his
findings.claim: The possessive suffix makes the wealth specifically the man's, so personal ownership stands beside the sentence's denial that it can rescue him.
findings.mechanism: The construct suffix both definites the noun and links it to the continuing participant.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony of a resource marked as personally owned failing at the exact point where personal protection is needed.
findings.containment: The possessive relation identifies ownership; it does not imply that ownership itself is the cause of the fall.

epistemic.reason: The supplied suffix and participant-chain evidence directly support personal ownership.

findings.title: The repeated possessive sound
findings.claim: The هُ sound in عَنْهُ and مَالُهُ audibly binds the protected man to the wealth attributed to him.
findings.mechanism: The same attached third-person suffix is heard first on the governed complement and then on the possessive noun.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence's sound briefly keeps person and possession together even as its meaning denies the possession's efficacy.
findings.containment: The sound relation supports the local bond; it does not replace the grammatical reference or make sound alone a semantic proof.

epistemic.reason: The supplied suffix-sound evidence identifies the repeated acoustic chain.

findings.title: Wealth tested as an agent
findings.claim: The sentence makes static wealth the subject of an availing verb, then shows that this apparent agency does not work for its owner.
findings.mechanism: The concrete noun occupies the verbal subject position while مَا denies the capability associated with that position.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the stockpile promoted to rescuer only to fail the rescue test.
findings.containment: The agent-like syntax is a semantic test within the clause; the wealth remains an inanimate possession.

epistemic.reason: The nominal root evidence and local subject attachment support the agent test.

findings.title: The local rescue verdict
findings.claim: The owned wealth is excluded from the act of saving or availing the man at the fall, becoming the concrete exhibit of non-rescue.
findings.mechanism: مَالُهُ is clause-bound to the negated يُغْنِى relation and is tested precisely where protection would matter.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah deny a particular rescue function, not merely say that wealth is temporary.
findings.containment: The verdict concerns this man's availing at the named crisis; it does not deny every ordinary benefit of material resources.

epistemic.reason: The supplied local verdict and clause-bound wealth evidence directly support non-rescue.

findings.title: The certain when
findings.claim: إِذَا with the following perfect verb presents the fall as the certain time when the denial is disclosed, rather than as an open possibility.
findings.mechanism: The temporal particle frames a perfect event as the future-certain point at which the main clause becomes manifest.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the crisis as an assured disclosure point built into the statement.
findings.containment: The temporal force sharpens the timing; it does not change the plain event named by the fall.

epistemic.reason: The supplied QAC timing and perfect-form evidence support the future-certain reading.

findings.title: Hardship given a fall-moment
findings.claim: The temporal clause turns the preceding hardship into a concrete fall-moment at which the wealth's failure is exhibited.
findings.mechanism: إِذَا supplies the timing and تَرَدَّىٰٓ supplies the event, giving the earlier consequence a visible scene.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can locate when the abstract promise of hardship becomes a lived crisis.
findings.containment: The supplied fall scene remains the ayah's local manifestation and does not erase the preceding hardship reading.

epistemic.reason: The temporal-clause support explicitly identifies the previous consequence's specified scene.

findings.title: The hinge between verdict and scene
findings.claim: إِذَا hinges the general verdict about wealth to the final scene that demonstrates it.
findings.mechanism: The particle introduces a temporal clause attached to the negated availing event, so the second beat explains where the first is seen.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader moves from rule to disclosure without losing either part of the ayah.
findings.containment: The hinge is temporal and local; it does not create a separate causal claim beyond the supplied attachment.

epistemic.reason: The supplied temporal-disclosure attachment directly supports the hinge.

findings.title: The same man reaches the fall
findings.claim: تَرَدَّىٰٓ is a perfect third-person masculine verb whose unexpressed subject continues the same man named through the preceding participant chain.
findings.mechanism: The perfect form supplies the event and the attachment evidence supplies its continuing subject.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader follows one person from possession and expected protection into the assured crisis.
findings.containment: The pronoun continuity identifies the supplied participant and does not introduce a new theological or narrative actor.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence directly support the continuing masculine subject.

findings.title: Ruin as a bounded covering pressure
findings.claim: Alongside the local fall, the supplied mantle family lets the ruin feel like a consequence wrapped around or taken on by the man, while the literal clause still names his fall or perishing.
findings.mechanism: The same final carrier bears the accepted fall sense; its qualified mantle relation meets the possessive person-link and the self-involved form, producing an image of an outcome attached to its wearer.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel ruin as something that has become his condition, while the ordinary fall remains fully recoverable.
findings.containment: The mantle family is image pressure only: no literal garment is asserted, and the fall/perishing sense governs the clause.

epistemic.reason: The packet preserves the mantle branch but explicitly narrows it under the local fall syntax, so the image is retained with a clear boundary.

branch_activations.activation: Fall carrier meets the person-bound possessive relation, allowing the supplied garment family to press the image of a condition attached to its wearer.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişiye giysi gibi bağlı duran, onu örten veya bezeyen yükümlülük ve nitelikler benzetmeyle aynı ad altında toplanır.
branch_activations.carrier: تَرَدَّىٰٓ taşıyıcısı düşüşün özne içine alan biçimini taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Kişisel iyelik ile yadsınan kurtarma ilişkisi, sonucun kişiye yapışan bir nitelik gibi hissedilmesini sağlar.
branch_activations.activation: The self-involved fall and attached possession give the mantle extension an independent image pressure without displacing the literal event.

branch_activations.boundary: This extension is metaphorical and qualified; no clothing, debt, or external obligation is added as a literal referent.

findings.title: The fall closes the scene
findings.claim: The final word sits inside the temporal clause and closes the ayah at the scene where wealth's non-availing is manifested.
findings.mechanism: The fall is placed at the end of the when-clause, after the denial, person, and resource have already been assembled.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader ends on the event that proves the preceding verdict in the ayah's own sequence.
findings.containment: The closing position consolidates the denial; it does not make the final verb independent of the temporal clause.

epistemic.reason: The final-word attachment and closure evidence directly support the disclosure scene.

findings.title: The fall's terminal ruin
findings.claim: The local ر د ي field makes تَرَدَّىٰٓ a fall into ruin or perishing, the terminal scene in which the wealth's promised efficacy is exposed.
findings.mechanism: The final root's falling-into-ruin branch meets إِذَا's crisis timing and the negated availing relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the named fall as a ruinous threshold, not merely an unspecified change of circumstance.
findings.containment: The terminal ruin remains the local man's fall; other root branches and a general doctrine of collapse are outside this finding.

epistemic.reason: The supplied falling-ruin branch and temporal clause support the terminal scene.

findings.title: Concentrated fatal-fall texture
findings.claim: The supplied low-occurrence profile and comparison evidence concentrate a fatal, downward texture around the final verb, while the local syntax keeps its referent as the man's fall.
findings.mechanism: A rare root field with a concrete fall/ruin profile gives the final carrier unusual downward density without displacing its local parse.
